'''Walter Gilman (Chapter 8)''' is a special [[ally]] used in [[The Three Armies of the King|scenario 8]] of the 1st Arkham Spanish League.

==Card info==
*-1 [[Focus]]
*+2 [[Lore]]
*-1 [[Speed]]

You must have Gilman as an ally in order to win the game.

==Notes==
This is one of multiple versions of the Walter Gilman ally used by different scenarios.
